description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget called BoardTile, representing a single square tile in a Tic Tac Toe game UI. It includes interactive animations, visual styling, and displays either 'X', 'O', or empty, with visual cues like highlighting and tap feedback.

classes.name: BoardTile
classes.description: A customizable, animated tile widget for the Tic Tac Toe board that shows X or O with visual effects and tap animations.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for this widget, returning an instance of _BoardTileState.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the animation controller and scale animation when the widget is inserted into the widget tree.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the animation controller to free resources.

methods.name: _handleTapDown
methods.description: Handles tap down gesture, triggers scale down animation if the tile is enabled.

methods.name: _handleTapCancel
methods.description: Resets the scale animation if tap is canceled.

methods.name: _handleTapUp
methods.description: Resets the scale animation after tap is completed.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the tile, including gesture detection, animated scaling, visual styling, and displaying the 'X', 'O', or empty.
